| colspan="6" align="left"|<small>'''Notes:'''</small>
{{refbegin}}
{{note|doubleorquits|<small>1</small>}} <small>Magali used a Double or Quits advantage and won her subsequent duel against Marie, earning immunity from the vote.</small><br />
{{note|combined|<small>2</small>}}<small>Combined Reward and Immunity Challenge.</small><br />
{{note|secretambassador|<small>3</small>}}<small>Laure used a Secret Ambassador advantage and became immune from elimination at the ambassadors meeting.</small><br />
{{note|ambassadors|<small>4</small>}}<small>At the ambassadors meeting, the three ambassadors agreed to vote Frédéric out of the game.</small><br />
{{note|necklace|<small>5</small>}}<small>An Immunity Necklace was played, negating all votes against its user.</small><br />
{{note|suddendeath|<small>6</small>}}<small>The castaway who finished last in the second individual Immunity Challenge and another castaway chosen by the winner of the challenge competed in a duel where the loser would be eliminated from the game. Thomas won the duel and earned immunity from Tribal Council while Mathieu was eliminated.</small><br />
{{note|blackbracelet|<small>7</small>}}<small>Lucie used a Black Bracelet on Laëtitia, stealing Laëtitia's Immunity Necklace.</small><br />
{{note|tieddestinies|<small>8</small>}}<small>Laëtitia was Vincent's partner during the Tied Destinies twist, therefore she was also eliminated when Vincent was voted out.</small><br />
{{note|suddendeath2|<small>9</small>}}<small>The castaway who finished last in the sixth individual Immunity Challenge would be eliminated from the game. Flavio came in last and was eliminated.</small><br />
{{note|finalfive|<small>10</small>}}<small>At the final five, the remaining castaways competed in an elimination challenge where two castaways would be eliminated from the game. Arnaud and Laure came in last and were eliminated.</small>
{{refend}}
